_comment: Diagram configuration for scripts/build_data_dictionary.py. Descriptions live in docs/data-dictionary.md; 'tables' may only fill a gap there ({table: {purpose, columns: {column: text}}}). 'groups' places each table in an area of the diagram (the first group is the core, drawn in detail). 'key_owners' names the table a key column belongs to when several tables use it as their key; 'extra_links' adds links no column name reveals; 'not_links' drops a link a column name suggests wrongly; 'mirrors' lets a history or backup table's column take the description of the same column of the table it copies.

groups.name: Core pipeline
groups.description: Records, their enrichment, the incidents they form, entities and ASD classifications.

groups.name: Discovery and retrieval
groups.description: Search queues, page fetches and the pages cited as evidence.

groups.name: Enrichment and evidence
groups.description: Enrichment audit, fact support, record identity and event-level facts.

groups.name: Deduplication audit and ledger
groups.description: Merge and split decisions, overrides, snapshots and adjudication caches.

groups.name: Judgements and calibration
groups.description: Stored model answers, final decisions, victim actions and organisation timelines.

groups.name: Entity resolution and aliases
groups.description: Names that are one organisation, names that are not, folds and profiles.

groups.name: Supplier incidents
groups.description: Breaches of a supplier and the customers' events linked to them.

groups.name: Quality and validation
groups.description: Quality runs and metrics, owner-reported validation cases and enrichment reports.

groups.name: History
groups.description: What was known when: append-only history of events, membership, links and entities.

groups.name: Configuration and legacy
groups.description: Source and industry configuration, and tables kept from earlier schemas.
